stemMarkdown: In how many of the years shown did revenue rise over the previous year while the profit margin fell?
solutionMarkdown:
Check each year-on-year move for the two conditions together:

- 2021: revenue up 400 to 520, margin up 10 to 12 — no
- 2022: revenue down 520 to 480 — no
- 2023: revenue up 480 to 650, margin down 15 to 12 — **yes**
- 2024: revenue up 650 to 800, margin up 12 to 14 — no

Exactly **1** year. 2023 is also the year with the second-highest profit, so "margin fell" and "the business did worse" are not the same statement.
